name: run_evolution_cycle
description: Execute a full self-evolution cycle on a target harness+identity. This will: generate frontier tasks, evaluate baseline, compute text gradients from failures, apply prompt modifications, gate the changes (accept/rollback), and archive results.

target_harness.description: Name of the harness to evolve (e.g., 'react_single')

target_identity.description: Name of the identity/agent to evolve (e.g., 'dante')
